account: AIZEN reports that CreditConnect-EV has been live in Indonesia since 2022. On 25 November 2022 AIZEN Global announced an agreement with NOA and SWAP, two Indonesian firms that run shared electric bikes. The company said that CreditConnect was already in use in Indonesia and Vietnam. In November 2023 AIZEN announced a partnership with Grab to finance electric motorcycles. In an account current as of June 2025, AIZEN reports that CreditConnect-EV has financed more than 20,000 electric two-wheelers in Indonesia. No source measures the effect on the income of borrowers or on net emissions. On 24 July 2025 the Korea Economic Daily reported that JB Financial Group had signed an agreement for a 40 percent stake in the Indonesian unit of AIZEN. The newspaper described AIZEN as a provider of rental and credit services for Grab and Gojek. JB Financial Group announced that JB Woori Capital planned to fund the purchase of motorcycles by AIZEN and loans to drivers.
